name: Grouparoo
description: Grouparoo was an open-source reverse-ETL application for syncing customer data from warehouses and databases to destination tools.
agentUseSummary: Grouparoo is unavailable as a Relay connection because the official project is archived at pre-1.0 v0.9.0, its Cloud product is no longer a current supported service, and every self-hosted deployment exposes its own origin, installed plugins, permissions, and generated Swagger contract. Relay will not collect instance keys or execute arbitrary customer-hosted API routes without a maintained provider contract.

blocked.label: Connect Grouparoo
blocked.description: Relay exposes no Grouparoo connection while the official project is archived and no maintained hosted contract exists.

blocked.label: Collect instance API key
blocked.description: API keys from archived, customer-operated Grouparoo instances are not collected or transmitted.

blocked.label: Access or synchronize data
blocked.description: Records, properties, groups, sources, destinations, schedules, runs, apps, plugins, and customer data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary instance interfaces
blocked.description: Customer-defined origins, deployment-generated Swagger routes, cookies, CSRF material, browser automation, scraping, arbitrary plugins, and raw responses are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Grouparoo action or credential path is exposed without a maintained provider and stable supported API distribution contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No Grouparoo wrappers are mounted because the archived self-hosted project has no current stable provider-operated API contract.
No Grouparoo wrappers are mounted because the archived self-hosted project has no current stable provider-operated API contract.

providerSetup.blocker: The official Grouparoo repository is archived, its latest release is pre-1.0 v0.9.0 from April 2022, and its documentation delegates exact API schemas to Swagger generated by each self-hosted instance according to installed plugins and permissions. Grouparoo Cloud is not presented as a current supported onboarding path.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Grouparoo unavailable and do not collect an instance API key or origin. Re-evaluate only if a maintained successor publishes a supported hosted API or a stable self-hosted integration contract with fixed versioned schemas, origin verification, security updates, credential lifecycle, compatibility policy, and distribution terms.

evidence.supports: The official Grouparoo repository is archived and read-only; its latest published release is v0.9.0 from April 2022.
Grouparoo documents self-hosted instance API keys and says each deployment exposes its own Swagger documentation at /swagger.
Grouparoo documents version-coupled plugins, community and commercial plugin variants, and deployment-specific source/destination capabilities.
Grouparoo's orchestration guide directs users to instance-specific API keys and each deployment's generated Swagger contract for schedules and runs.
